description: Replacement windows and doors, external and internal wall insulation and installation of mechanical extract ventilation to kitchen and bathroom.
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
The external finishing materials shall match those used in the construction of the existing building and/or areas of hard surfacing. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans, 1234 40001 C02400024000340005 C0240006 C0240007 C0240008 C0240009 C0240010 C0240011 C0240012 C0240013 C0240014 C0240015 C0240016 C0240017 C0240018 C0240019 C02Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.
